packages.name: Architecture Agent
packages.description: Turn requirements into an implementation design and technical decisions.
packages.delivery_gate: Versioned design artifacts, an authorized agent implementation, source provenance, and human design review.

packages.name: Testing Agent
packages.description: Run functional and integration checks against an exact candidate.
packages.delivery_gate: A real testing provider, protected test policy, isolated execution, and candidate-bound reports.

packages.name: Code Review Agent
packages.description: Explain code risks and request focused revisions before human approval.
packages.delivery_gate: An authorized review provider, immutable patch identity, structured findings, and no automatic approval authority.

packages.name: Security Scan
packages.description: Inspect source and dependencies for vulnerabilities with retained evidence.
packages.delivery_gate: Pinned scanner versions, scoped execution, severity policy, and reports tied to the exact candidate.

packages.name: Knowledge Retrieval
packages.description: Retrieve approved project knowledge with source and revision references.
packages.delivery_gate: A real retrieval provider, document permissions, source/version provenance, retention, and project isolation.

packages.name: Pull Request
packages.description: Propose an approved candidate for team review in its repository.
packages.delivery_gate: A repository connector, explicit write grants, approved source identity, and idempotent creation with audit evidence.

packages.name: Release
packages.description: Promote approved work into a controlled release environment.
packages.delivery_gate: A real release executor, environment scope, release policy, explicit approval, and retained deployment evidence.

packages.name: Feedback Intake
packages.description: Turn issues and product feedback into traceable successor requirements.
packages.delivery_gate: Authorized feedback connectors, deduplication, attribution, and explicit lineage to a new requirement.
